abstract.p: Disclosed herein are Advanced RNA Targeting (ARNATAR) oligomeric compounds, thoughtfully designed compounds for inhibiting gene expression through the RISC pathway. Such compounds are useful in methods for reducing expression of certain genes, many of which are associated with a variety of diseases and disorders.
